summary: Learn ISSA 5000 engagement planning, evidence, controls, and readiness. Build an ESG assurance-readiness plan through practical exercises.
lede: Sustainability assurance training prepares auditors, sustainability officers, controllers, and ESG reporting teams to plan assurance work and link claims with criteria, controls, and evidence. Participants practise engagement scoping, materiality and risk assessment, evidence mapping, and control walkthrough planning using illustrative sustainability information. They also distinguish limited from reasonable assurance and develop a readiness plan that identifies gaps and prioritizes preparation.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who prepare, review, govern, or assure ESG, climate, and sustainability information under ISSA 5000. It suits practitioners who need to connect reporting claims with criteria, controls, evidence, and an appropriate assurance approach.
prerequisites: Working familiarity with sustainability or ESG reporting, internal audit, external audit, financial control, or assurance work is recommended. No coding or programming is required.
